line: Crowley on Atu XII: the letter Mem, the element Water, and the sacrifice of the male child (pdf p87, p89).

sections.title: Letter and element
sections.line: Crowley on the card attributed to the letter Mem and representing Water (pdf p87), and on Mem as one of the three great Mother Letters (pdf p89).

quotes.quote: This card, attributed to the letter Mem, represents the element of Water.
Yet the card in itself is essentially a glyph of Water; Mem is one of the three great Mother Letters

sections.title: The Paths and the letters
sections.line: Crowley on the Paths that join the ten numbers on the Tree of Life and on one letter to each path (pdf p36).

sections.title: Baptism and sacrifice
sections.line: Crowley on baptism and death (pdf p87) and on the sacrifice of a male child of perfect innocence and high intelligence (pdf p89).

quotes.quote: it is a baptism which is also a death.
The Atu represents the sacrifice of “a male child of perfect innocence and high intelligence”
